$comment: Single source of truth for issue labels required by AGENTS.md. Read by issue-labels.yml and pr-policy.yml. Keep the issue forms' dropdown options in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE in sync. 'markers' are optional labels with a fixed meaning (docs/process/project-management.md); the checks don't require them.

markers.epic: Parent issue that groups features and tasks as sub-issues
markers.needs owner: Needs the owner: a login, a payment, or a decision agents cannot make
markers.shared-component: Watch out: changes shared code many pages use; check every page that uses it
